boundary.statement: The line 2theta+kappa=6/25 ties the strict target and is not closed without an additional margin.

claim_boundary: This artifact closes only the strict fraction-budget wedge. The boundary and residual packet atlas remain open; no powered, density, or interval gain is proved.

fraction_wedge.statement: Primitive packet injectivity and O(Q^2) available fractions close every cell with 2theta+kappa<6/25, both in packet count and weighted pair census.

literature_scope.statement: Huang arXiv:1403.7388 definition (1.1) and Theorem 1 use a common denominator for both rational coordinates and do not directly cover the mixed grid-denominator packets here.
